2608.13420.title: Enhancing Virtual Agents through SLMs and Edge-Computing: An Exploratory Evaluation of Think and Memory Processes
2608.13420.paper_summary: Embodied intelligent virtual agents are expected to operate as persistent, adaptive, and context-aware entities within complex virtual and Metaverse worlds. However, implementing cognitively capable agents in such environments is conceptually and technologically challenging. Among a range of blueprints and development approaches, the Cognitive Embodied Agent Architecture (CEAA) has been developed as an implementation-oriented framework for architecting components of perception, memory, reasoning, planning, and embodied action. Considering the recent advances in edge computing and generative AI language models, this paper explores the use of Small Language Models (SLMs) to support edge-based operation of selected CEAA components, focusing on "Think" and "Memory" as processes central to cognitive orchestration and persistence of virtual agents in interactive virtual worlds. An edge-based virtual agent gateway system was developed and evaluated on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX using Qwen2.5 models of different sizes, exploring the system's capability to process service requests and handle memory-driven conversations. A series of simulation experiments evaluated routing accuracy, memory-read performance, and latency, demonstrating an SLM-driven prototype agent system that partially implements selected CEAA processes to support the development of embodied agents whose cognitive "brain" can operate efficiently and contextually for interactive experiences in immersive virtual worlds.
2608.13420.paper_summary_zh: 具身智能虛擬代理預期將在複雜的虛擬和元宇宙世界中作為持久的、自適應的和具上下文感知的實體運作。<lb/>然而，在這樣的環境中實施具有認知能力的代理在概念上和技術上都面臨挑戰。在各種藍圖和開發方法中，認知具身代理架構（CEAA）被開發為一個以實施為導向的框架，用於架構感知、記憶、推理、規劃和具身行動的組件。<lb/>考慮到邊緣計算和生成式 AI 語言模型的最新進展，本文探討了使用小型語言模型（SLMs）來支持選定 CEAA 組件的邊緣運作，重點關注“思考”和“記憶”這兩個過程，這些過程對於虛擬代理在互動虛擬世界中的認知協調和持久性至關重要。<lb/>一個基於邊緣的虛擬代理網關系統在 NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 上開發並評估，使用不同大小的 Qwen2.5 模型，探索該系統處理服務請求和處理基於記憶的對話的能力。<lb/>一系列模擬實驗評估了路由準確性、記憶讀取性能和延遲，展示了一個由 SLM 驅動的原型代理系統，該系統部分實施了選定的 CEAA 過程，以支持具身代理的發展，使其認知“大腦”能夠高效且具上下文地運作，為沉浸式虛擬世界中的互動體驗提供支持。
